Let me write it carefully.\n\n```python\ndef parse_packets(data: bytes):\n    packets = []\n    i = 0\n    while i < len(data):\n        start = i\n        b = data[i]; i += 1\n        if not (b & 0x80):\n            raise ValueError(\"bad packet header\")\n        if b & 0x40:  # new format\n            tag = b & 0x3F\n            lb = data[i];
